info.name: Score a recorded audio file against an expected script (batch).

items.docs: Single-file (batch) scripted scoring. Submit a recorded audio file plus the expected script and an api_plan; returns sentence, word, and phoneme-level pronunciation scores with fluency and intonation. Request/response schemas are partner-gated.

info.name: Score a recorded audio file with no reference script (batch).

items.docs: Single-file (batch) unscripted scoring. Submit spontaneous audio and an api_plan; returns a transcript plus pronunciation, prosody, fluency, grammar, and vocabulary analysis. Request/response schemas are partner-gated.
